source.authorship_evidence_basis: Later verified Kalaignar anthology item correspondence (`kalaignar-song-022`); not original-booklet primary-source item credit.

source_tamil_lines: எந்தன் முகந்தானே ராஜா உமக்கு நான் தான் ராணி
english_lines: New jewel-dove!... that is me alone. (Mani)
With love that longs for you, my heart leaps toward you,
A rose grove, a mullai garden,
That is my very face, Raja; for you, I alone am Rani,
I shall give you delight indeed! (Mani)
notes: The source refrain cue `(மணி)` is retained as `(Mani)` rather than expanded.
`முல்லை` remains `mullai` to preserve the specific flower/cultural image instead of flattening it to generic jasmine.
The compact source phrase `எந்தன் முகந்தானே` is rendered conservatively as `that is my very face` without altering the Tamil.

translator_notes: The romantic flower/bird/deer imagery and direct Raja/Rani word-play are retained.
Authorship remains at later-anthology attribution tier.
